verdict.rationale: smolagents documents running agents step by step (`agent.step`), accessing memory, and `agent.replay()`, which suits long tool calls. None of the evidence shows checkpoint persistence, resuming a run after a process restart or deploy, or any durable-execution integration. These are developer building blocks a user could use to build durability, not the capability itself, and `push_to_hub` shares agent definitions rather than run state.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can run long-lived agents durably across process restarts and deploys, natively or via durable-execution integrations
